title: Bob Dylan’s Guitarist Quit — So a Blues Player from Chicago Stepped In!
summary:
Imagine you're a musician playing at a small club in Chicago on Saturday. Then on Monday, you're on stage with Bob Dylan in front of 5,000 people! That's exactly what happened to Joel Paterson.

Bob Dylan's band had some drama. Guitarist Bob Britt quit suddenly with a "Sayonara Bobby" Facebook post. Another guitarist, Julian Lage, had a prior commitment in Brooklyn. So Dylan needed a new guitarist fast — and he found Joel Paterson, a blues guitarist from Chicago.

Paterson usually plays at the Green Mill Cocktail Lounge, a tiny venue that holds about 150 people. But on June 29, he walked onto the stage at the Moody Amphitheater in Austin, Texas, and played 16 songs with Dylan — all by himself! Fans said he did an amazing job.

It's still unclear if Paterson will stay with the band or if Dylan will hire someone else. Julian Lage might come back for some shows. But for now, Paterson is living every musician's dream: from a small club to a big stage in just two days!
why_it_matters: You never know when a big opportunity might come, so if you work hard at what you love, you might find yourself on a big stage someday.
